description: React component for a board switcher dialog with search functionality, allowing users to find and select boards within a team-based application.

classes.name: BoardSwitcherDialog
classes.description: React functional component providing a dialog to search and switch between boards.

methods.name: selectBoard
methods.description: Navigates to the selected board's page and closes the dialog.

methods.name: searchHandler
methods.description: Handles search queries, fetches matching boards, and renders search results.

methods.name: handleEnterKeyPress
methods.description: Handles keyboard event for selecting a board with Enter key.
